import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Brush

import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.LinearGradientShader
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Shader
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.ShaderBrush
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin

// Untested on device.
// Offsets are pixels of a 1000 x 1000 box, the CSS gradient line of 180deg.
val gradientBrush = Brush.linearGradient(
    colorStops = arrayOf(
        0.0f to Color(0xFFFF0000),
        0.06667f to Color(0xEEFF0000),
        0.13333f to Color(0xDDFF0000),
        0.2f to Color(0xCCFF0000),
        0.26667f to Color(0xBBFF0000),
        0.33333f to Color(0xAAFF0000),
        0.4f to Color(0x99FF0000),
        0.46667f to Color(0x88FF0000),
        0.53333f to Color(0x77FF0000),
        0.6f to Color(0x66FF0000),
        0.66667f to Color(0x55FF0000),
        0.73333f to Color(0x44FF0000),
        0.8f to Color(0x33FF0000),
        0.86667f to Color(0x22FF0000),
        0.93333f to Color(0x11FF0000),
        1.0f to Color(0x000000FF),
    ),
    start = Offset(500.0f, 0.0f),
    end = Offset(500.0f, 1000.0f),
)

// Size-independent variant: recomputes the CSS gradient line for the size it is drawn at.
val gradientShaderBrush = object : ShaderBrush() {
    override fun createShader(size: Size): Shader {
        val radians = Math.toRadians(180.0)
        val dx = sin(radians).toFloat()
        val dy = -cos(radians).toFloat()
        val length = abs(size.width * dx) + abs(size.height * dy)
        val center = Offset(size.width / 2f, size.height / 2f)
        val half = Offset(dx * length / 2f, dy * length / 2f)
        return LinearGradientShader(
            from = center - half,
            to = center + half,
            colors = listOf(Color(0xFFFF0000), Color(0xEEFF0000), Color(0xDDFF0000), Color(0xCCFF0000), Color(0xBBFF0000), Color(0xAAFF0000), Color(0x99FF0000), Color(0x88FF0000), Color(0x77FF0000), Color(0x66FF0000), Color(0x55FF0000), Color(0x44FF0000), Color(0x33FF0000), Color(0x22FF0000), Color(0x11FF0000), Color(0x000000FF)),
            colorStops = listOf(0.0f, 0.06667f, 0.13333f, 0.2f, 0.26667f, 0.33333f, 0.4f, 0.46667f, 0.53333f, 0.6f, 0.66667f, 0.73333f, 0.8f, 0.86667f, 0.93333f, 1.0f),
        )
    }
}

# Untested in Godot.
# The Gradient interpolates linearly between its points (interpolation_mode is left at its default).
# fill_from and fill_to are the CSS gradient line of 180deg in a box with aspect ratio 1:1 (width:height).
var gradient := Gradient.new()
gradient.offsets = PackedFloat32Array([0.0, 0.06667, 0.13333, 0.2, 0.26667, 0.33333, 0.4, 0.46667, 0.53333, 0.6, 0.66667, 0.73333, 0.8, 0.86667, 0.93333, 1.0])
gradient.colors = PackedColorArray([Color8(255, 0, 0), Color8(255, 0, 0, 238), Color8(255, 0, 0, 221), Color8(255, 0, 0, 204), Color8(255, 0, 0, 187), Color8(255, 0, 0, 170), Color8(255, 0, 0, 153), Color8(255, 0, 0, 136), Color8(255, 0, 0, 119), Color8(255, 0, 0, 102), Color8(255, 0, 0, 85), Color8(255, 0, 0, 68), Color8(255, 0, 0, 51), Color8(255, 0, 0, 34), Color8(255, 0, 0, 17), Color8(0, 0, 255, 0)])

var texture := GradientTexture2D.new()
texture.gradient = gradient
texture.fill = GradientTexture2D.FILL_LINEAR
texture.fill_from = Vector2(0.5, 0.0)
texture.fill_to = Vector2(0.5, 1.0)
texture.width = 256
texture.height = 256
